## Summary

<!-- What does this change do, and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — no behaviour change
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `docs` / `chore` / `ci` — tooling or docs

## Test plan

- [ ] Unit tests added/updated for changed behaviour
- [ ] E2E tests added/updated for user-facing API journeys (when applicable)
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes locally

## Checklist

- [ ] Targets `develop` (features/fixes) or `main` only for release hotfixes
- [ ] Conventional commit history (squash/rebase friendly)
- [ ] No secrets committed
- [ ] README / OpenAPI updated if the public contract changed
